knowledge:
- key_parameters: inseq=A 147-bp DNA sequence, provided either as a character string or a DNAString object ;; species=The species model to use for prediction, specified as "sc" (S. cerevisiae), "sp" (S. pombe), or "mm" (M. musculus)
- alternatives: NuPoP=The parental package, which should be preferred for dHMM-based prediction or predicting nucleosome occupancy in the original way, as the dHMM-based prediction function was removed from nuCpos
- when_to_use: When analyzing a specific 147-bp DNA sequence to predict its nucleosome positioning capability, overall histone binding affinity, or local histone binding affinity across 13 subnucleosomal segments (SHLs) using chemical-map-based models
- pitfalls: The input sequence (inseq) must be exactly 147 bp in length ;; Using DNAString objects requires loading the Biostrings package ;; The dHMM-based prediction function is no longer available in this package and has been delegated back to NuPoP

workflows.name: nucleosome_affinity_prediction
workflows.intent: Calculate whole and local histone binding affinity (HBA) scores for a 147-bp DNA sequence to predict nucleosome positioning.
input: sequence.RData (a 147-bp DNA sequence stored as a character string)
sequence_DNAString.RData (a 147-bp DNA sequence stored as a DNAString object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the nuCpos package and input sequence ;; 2. Calculate the whole nucleosomal HBA score using the HBA function ;; 3. Calculate local HBA scores for 13 subnucleosomal segments using the localHBA function ;; 4. Visualize local HBA scores using a barplot
workflows.code:
library(nuCpos)
load(system.file("extdata", "inseq.RData", package = "nuCpos"))
HBA(inseq = inseq, species = "sc")
load(system.file("extdata", "INSEQ_DNAString.RData", package = "nuCpos"))
HBA(inseq = INSEQ, species = "sc")
localHBA(inseq = inseq, species = "sc")
barplot(localHBA(inseq = inseq, species = "sc"), names.arg = LETTERS[1:13], xlab = "Nucleosomal subsegments", ylab = "local HBA", main = "Local HBA scores for inseq")
